newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia registers foreign investment increase.
newsitem.headline: Colombia registers foreign investment increase.

text.p: Direct foreign investment in Colombia, excluding the volatile oil sector, increased by 15 percent between January and October 1996 compared to the same period in 1995, according to Coinvertir, the country's foreign investment board.
It said direct foreign investment increased by $272 million in October -- the latest month for which official figures are available -- an 86 percent increase over October 1995.
Direct foreign investment excluding oil totalled $1.27 billion between January and October 1996, Coinvertir said in a report made available to Reuters Monday.
